# Unovie.AI

> Physical AI for deep-tech manufacturing. Unovie designs, builds and operates custom Edge-AI Agentic Systems for battery, chip, space, robotics, defense and advanced energy manufacturers, at a fixed scope and cost, on Unovie's custom-built AMD or NVIDIA hardware accelerators. AgentMesh puts AI at the machine, on every signal a next-generation line produces. AgentNexus runs AI agents across every site. A language model is never on the path that moves equipment, and every decision is recorded in a signed Evidence Log.

Figures on this site marked "target" are design targets, not measurements.

## About Unovie
- An engineering-first, AI-native company in Austin, Texas, serving customers nationally.
- Founders with 20+ years each in OT and Physical AI. Four years building the platform.
- Customers: next-generation manufacturers in battery and energy storage, chip fabs and their suppliers, space and aerospace, robotics and autonomous systems, defense and dual-use manufacturing, and advanced energy and nuclear (non-safety roles only).
- Safety boundary: Unovie is not a safety system and makes no SIL claim. Safety decisions stay with the customer's PLC, safety system and operators.
- Security: designed against NIST SP 800-53 and the NIST AI RMF (designed against, not certified). Compliance is decided by the customer's assessor.

## How Unovie engages
1. Site audit: no charge, 1–2 days on site.
2. Paid pilot: 6 weeks, $40–60K, one domain kit on the customer's own data. Credited in full against a production site signed within 90 days.
3. Production: about one quarter after the pilot.
4. Fleet: new lines and sites reuse the same setup; AgentNexus connects them.
Pricing is per monitored asset and domain kit, never per seat or per camera. Hardware can be bought or taken as a service.

## Platform
- [AgentMesh](https://unovie.ai/platform/agentmesh.html): AI at the machine, on every signal a next-generation line produces: robots, vision, sensors and test rigs. A compact 3U pod at the line, air-gapped. Decides within 30 ms (target). Acts only on low-consequence outputs, such as a reject gate or a rework diverter. Anything touching safety becomes an alarm and a request that the PLC, cell controller and operators decide. Every device is described with its limits, and the pod enforces them.
- [AgentNexus](https://unovie.ai/platform/agentnexus.html): AI agents working across every site. Drafts maintenance plans, NCRs, quality records and work orders for a named person to approve. Answers within 0.5 s (target). Never moves equipment. Runs in the customer's own enclave, as one rack for the whole fleet. Connects out only through one gate the customer controls and can audit (Claude and the customer's ERP, in design). Private work stays local.
- Evidence Log: a signed record of every decision that the customer can audit.
- Kiln: tested, signed, reversible improvements. Nothing new switches on until it has proven itself on cases it has never seen.
- Operator HMI: each AgentMesh pod has an operator screen; AgentNexus has a fleet screen.
- Engineering teams can book a walkthrough with our engineers: https://unovie.ai/contact.html

## Agentic jobs
Packaged domain kits, deployed in weeks:
- Robot & Motion Health: joint, servo and gearbox drift caught before it scraps parts or stops the line.
- Vision Quality Inspection: DeepVision at the cell, on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor.
- Battery Line & Storage Safety: weld and formation checks in line; thermal-runaway warning on storage sites (alarm only).
- Fab Utilities Watch: pumps, chillers, scrubbers and gas systems at the fab and its suppliers.
- Electrical Health: drives, inverters and switchgear.
- Test Campaign Monitor: flags to the test conductor during a run; post-test report drafted.
- Factory Network Watch: unauthorized writes and unusual commands on the factory network.
- Quality Records & NCRs: drafted for sign-off, in English or Spanish.

## Sectors
- [Battery & energy storage](https://unovie.ai/sectors/battery.html): cell lines and storage sites.
- [Chip fabs & suppliers](https://unovie.ai/sectors/fabs.html): fab utilities and supplier plants.
- [Space & aerospace](https://unovie.ai/sectors/space.html): test stands and vehicle lines.
- [Robotics, drones & autonomy](https://unovie.ai/sectors/robotics.html): robot cells, drones and vessels.
- [Defense & dual-use](https://unovie.ai/sectors/defense.html): shipyards and dual-use factories.
- [Advanced energy & nuclear](https://unovie.ai/sectors/energy.html): balance of plant, non-safety only.
- [FAQ](https://unovie.ai/faq.html): data, safety, hardware and pilot cost.

## Hardware
All options run the same platform on Unovie's custom-built AMD or NVIDIA hardware accelerators.
- [AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395](https://unovie.ai/device-platform.html#ryzen-ai-max-395): the AgentMesh pod at the line and the AgentNexus rack for the fleet. Runs today.
- [NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor](https://unovie.ai/device-platform.html#agx-thor): robotics and DeepVision at the tool. Available per project.
- [NVIDIA DGX Spark](https://unovie.ai/device-platform.html#dgx-spark): the AI engineering lab and a small AgentNexus for one site. Available per project.
- [Qualcomm QCS6490](https://unovie.ai/device-platform.html#qcs6490): mobile and remote equipment, feeding the nearest AgentMesh pod.

## Resources
